name: Ozzie "The Deep End" Lindqvist
fightingStyle: Slow, tricky zoner. Low rumbling notes roll along the ground like waves, and the long instrument's curved bell hooks opponents in close. Hard to approach and unpredictable.
personality: Quiet, mysterious and dryly funny. Always seems to know more than he says. Often found reading in a corner of the locker room.
whyTheyFight: Nobody notices the bass clarinet until it's missing. Ozzie fights to show the whole band how much the low notes hold everything up, and to settle a long argument with the clarinets about whose instrument is cooler.
taunt: You can't hear me. That's the point.
ending: Ozzie wins Band Wars and arranges a halftime piece built entirely on low woodwinds. On the dark football field the rumble rattles the bleachers, and the band finally gets why he never stops talking about 'the foundation.'
